messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1: Halcyon wants to pull their private pilot earlier by ~10 days. They require customer-managed keys (HSM), p95 < 350ms, and burst handling up to 100 QPS. Need a rapid triage so we can tell them whats feasible.
Sam: Can we get expected payload sizes and avg tokens per request? latency planning depends a lot on sequence length.
Priya: Halcyon expects ~200 token avg request, some spikes to 500. Model: 13B open variant but willing to accept a 7B if needed.
Li: Runtime: continuous batching + KV cache should keep p95 under 350 for 7B easily. 13B is borderline on our current node shapes unless we reserve more GPU slots and enforce strict batching. Also need warm caches for repeating prefixes.
Noor: Infra: Reserved Dedicated pool for HSM-backed traffic is possible but lead time is ~2 weeks for procurement + network setup in their region. We also need VPC peering and flow logs. If timeline < 2 weeks, we can do hosted-kms fallback in ~4 days.
Carla: Security: HSM onboarding checklist: customer attestation form, HSM auth test, KMS integration runbook, audit-forwarding. Realistically 8 business days for full attestation and policy approvals.
Priya: Options: A) Hold to HSM and delay launch; B) Redwood-hosted KMS fallback + commit to cutover later; C) Smaller model (7B) + HSM to reduce infra footprint. Thoughts?
Sam: Fastest path = hosted-KMS fallback + 7B. Minimizes infra lead and should meet p95. We'll document risk and a clear cutover plan if customer insists on HSM later.
Li: Routing idea (runtime): prefer HSM-pool when flagged, else route to hosted-kms pool. Also add rollout guard to enforce p95 during canary: reject if p95 > 400ms for 5m window. Pseudocode: ```
route:
  - if request.customer.hsm == true and pool.hsm_ready == true:
      target: pool-hsm
  - else:
      target: pool-hosted-kms
canary_guard:
  duration: 5m
  metric: latency.p95
  threshold_ms: 400
  action: rollback
```
Noor: I can stand up the hosted-kms pool in ~3 business days once we lock model and slot counts. HSM pool needs security approvals + infra ticket.
Carla: If we go hosted-KMS fallback, I'll prepare a customer-facing risk blurb + the mitigations (audit logs, restricted key access, SLA on key access). Also need to record the change in the SOW.
Priya: Draft action items: 
- Security: Carla to publish HSM checklist + customer-facing risk blurb (EOD).
- Infra: Noor to quantify GPU slot delta for 13B vs 7B and earliest reserve date (tomorrow).
- Runtime: Li to implement routing + canary_guard prototype and perf numbers (48h).
- Product: Priya to update SOW with fallback paths and acceptance criteria (today).
- Eng: Sam to estimate token costs and prewarm memory budget for chosen model (tomorrow).
- Ops: infra-bot to create ticket and schedule a 30m sync.

infra-bot: Created ticket RDW-2048 "Halcyon private pilot onramp: HSM/KMS gating" and scheduled meeting 1778890800 (2pm PT). Assigned: Carla, Noor, Li, Sam, Priya.
Priya: Thanks. Please review the SOW draft in the doc before the sync. If HSM slips, default plan = hosted-KMS + 7B with explicit rollback/cutover runbook. Will notify Halcyon with timeline options and risk statement. :thumbsup:
